indicator_name: Bank loans to the economy, principal outstanding at the start of the month, by borrower's industry, incl. overdue (analytical presentation)
description: Кредиты банковского сектора экономике, основной долг на начало месяца, по отраслям заёмщиков, в т.ч. просроченный (аналитическое представление)
unit: million KZT, at the start of the month
methodology: NBK formId=488 (315 209 rows, 2023-02 … ; items are sums). Items as LOANS_ISSUED_BY_INDUSTRY plus <industry>.OVERDUE and OVERDUE (overdue principal), STB (second-tier banks) and NON_BANK (the rest of the banking sector). Stocks dated by report_date, the 1st of the month after the reference month (end-of-August stock = 2026-09-01), as BANK_LOANS_STB_*. STB at 2026-09-01 is 42 825 457.5 mln KZT, equal to BANK_LOANS_STB_TOTAL (NBK's historical xlsx) to the tenge (checked 2026-11-07). Report dates from 2026-05-01 fetched; earlier values kept from the archive.
